title: eid aayi hai rajab shaban ki
body:
eid aayi hai rajab shaban ki
salle ala ka shor utha
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra ke gharaane ki ye khushiyaan hain
mubaarak eid mubaarak
<<DIVIDER>>
eid aayi hai rajab shaabaan ki
tin pisar hain haidar ke
<<DIVIDER>>
tinon rajab me aaye hain
aamade baaqir huwi pehli rajab ko marhaba
<<DIVIDER>>
paanchwi aayi rajab aaye naqi salle ala
daswi rajab ko aaye taqi kehte hain jinhe
<<DIVIDER>>
farzande raza
ye tajalli hai dile imraan ki
<<DIVIDER>>
no rajab ko aaye hain
asghar ibne shaahe hoda
<<DIVIDER>>
aa gaya zehra ke gulshan me gule umme rabab
tisre baabul hawaaej ka mila jis ko khitaab
<<DIVIDER>>
arsh pe qudsi jhoom rahe hain aur zameen pe
buturaab
<<DIVIDER>>
jaan hain ye sayyade zishaan ki
tera rajab ko aaye ali
<<DIVIDER>>
tera rajab ko aaye ali
wo jahaan me aa gaya jo ho gaya ghaalib laqab
<<DIVIDER>>
aamade binte asad par shak huwi diwaar jab
khush huwa kaaba aur payambar bole abu talib ke lab
<<DIVIDER>>
ye pisar tasweer hai subhaan ki
bibi zainab ki wilaadat
<<DIVIDER>>
hai pehli shaabaan ko
shabbar o shabbir jaise bhayi ki hamshir hai
<<DIVIDER>>
malka e sharm o haya hai waarise tatheer hai
shaan me zehra baat me haidar azm me ye
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir hai
pehli aayat sabr ke quraan ki
<<DIVIDER>>
shaabaan ki hai tisri
aur aamad shabbir ki
<<DIVIDER>>
raahib o fitrus pukaare aa gaya mera sakhi
arsh se jhula jhulaane aa gaye jibreel bhi
<<DIVIDER>>
raaqibe doshe ehmade mursal fakhre khuda aur
fakhre ali
<<DIVIDER>>
ye khabar hai tisri shaabaan ki
chothi sahar shaabaan ki
<<DIVIDER>>
aur aamad abbas ki
god me le kar ali bole mera akkaas hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye dile zainab dile shabbir ka ehsaas hai
maine dua me maanga tha jisko han ye wohi
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas hai
hai sanad allah ke ehsaan ki
<<DIVIDER>>
aayi thi shaabaan ki saat
ibne hasan qaasim ke saath
<<DIVIDER>>
jab liya aaghosh me farwa pukaari ay khuda
hubahu hai baap ki surat ye mera laadla
<<DIVIDER>>
meri ibaadat meri riyaazat ka ye diya hai tu ne
sila
<<DIVIDER>>
laaj rakhli tu ne mere maan ki
gyaara thi shaabaan ki
<<DIVIDER>>
thi wilaadat akbar ki
dekh kar is chaand ko wo chaand bhi sharmaa
<<DIVIDER>>
gaya
umme layla ne kaha lo aa gaye phir mustafa
<<DIVIDER>>
is ke husn ka khums nikaala tab yusuf ko husn
mila
<<DIVIDER>>
maang le kheir zuleikha jism o jaan ki
mehdiye doraan ki aamad
<<DIVIDER>>
hai pandra shaabaan ko
ay khusha qismat zameen par aa gaya wo
<<DIVIDER>>
maahtaab
wo ujaala din ka hai jaanashine buturaab
<<DIVIDER>>
mazhare yazdaan ka wo mazhar noore mujassam
laajawaab
<<DIVIDER>>
laaj rakhne aa gaya yazdaan ki
ehlebeyt ki khushiyon me
<<DIVIDER>>
saare hussaini shaamil hain
ek duje se gale mil kar mubaarak baad do
<<DIVIDER>>
pehn ke kapre naye ghar ghar charaagha bhi
karo
<<DIVIDER>>
saare hussaini mazhar aur farhaan ki tarha mil ke kaho
eid aayi hai rajab shaabaan ki
author: Farhan Ali
